metadata.description: Jinko travel plugins for Cursor and Grok Bot

plugins.name: jinko
plugins.description: Search flights, hotels and car rentals, book trips, and manage bookings with the Jinko Travel API. Connects to the Jinko MCP server for live pricing, trip management, cancellation and payment.

plugins.name: jinko-grok
plugins.description: Search and book live flights, hotels, and enabled car rentals, manage trips, and service Jinko bookings in Grok Bot through the anonymous Jinko Grok MCP server.
